note: Base ER-31 corrections only; the errata's optional reliability variant (remove 5F/6C, 6C/6-; add 5F/6E, 6E/6-, 4E/6C) is not applied. Each trip asserts only the indicator light the floor table binds to the called floor, checked after a 6 s rest window (generous at 25 rpm). No until on the floor light: output light N is in series with relay N's coil (NA/NE, NB/N-), so output light 3 (and 2) comes on when the call is stored, before the car moves. An until would match before arrival, and the at-rest expect shows the called floor's light, not arrival by itself; arrival (rest on c12, then c7, at MV601-REF-A) is pinned by the digest and golden. Not asserted (not printed as observables): the dial position at rest (the page prints each pad as a pair, D12-D13 / D6-D7, and an expect cannot say 'either'), the other floor lights going off, and the step 6 pushbutton interlock (the printed procedure never presses during travel). The ER-31 between-contacts hang is a separate regression case (rotary.md section 7) needing a non-default coast; not exercised here. Trips the knife-edge trigger (minDecisionUa 4, a ramp-tick sampling artifact per the 2026-10-13 triage); blessed under BLESS-ROBUSTNESS, all six perturbations held.
